headline: Meta pauses Muse chat-sharing after researchers find exposed AI chats
summary: Meta has paused its Muse AI assistant's conversation-sharing feature after security researchers at Claroc found more than 6,800 shared conversations publicly exposed through public DNS records, some containing internal company documents. Researchers say a single query was enough to surface thousands of the exposed conversations by title.

claims.statement: Meta paused its Muse chat-sharing feature after researchers found shared conversations publicly exposed online.
